recurring_competitor_patterns.implication: SERP presence does not justify mass city×service pages; require firsthand work and unique buyer questions.
Offer a bounded inquiry/audit only if capacity and evidence support it; avoid unsubstantiated guarantees.
A direct relationship and transparent price/scope can be credible early positioning.
Every Lancaster term and evidence record must say Lancaster NY/Erie County.

content_gaps: Plain-language cost and scope comparison: what the buyer gets, what changes price, ownership, payment milestones and timeline.
Build SEO versus ongoing SEO: titles, headings, crawl/index controls, schema and performance foundation versus reporting, content, local profiles and iteration.
Evidence-labeled work: owned-site, paid-client and concept labels with dates, role, screenshots/data and limitations.
Care boundaries: supported stack, backups/restore drill, response hours, edits, security responsibilities and cancellation.
Rescue/migration boundary: diagnosis first, supported stacks and excluded emergency/malware claims.
Local logistics and GBP eligibility for a service-area operation; no implied office or town duplicates.
Customer measurement questions: qualified inquiries, source confidence and what rankings can/cannot prove.
Motion/accessibility/performance tradeoffs for a visually distinctive site.
method_limits: No Google Trends was used; no normalized trend index is treated as volume.
No automated city×service pages are recommended.
Web query results do not establish live rankings or a Google local pack.
All estimates are hypotheses to validate with Search Console, lead logs and buyer conversations after launch.
